title: T10-T11 estimated segmental ROM without rib cage, pooled review (Borkowski 2016)

quantity.name: ROM (review estimate)
quantity.definition: median and range across study means of estimated segmental ROM (multi-segment ROM divided by number of segments in many studies), specimens without rib cage, pure moments 1.5-8 Nm

source.authors: Borkowski SL, Tamrazian E, Bowen RE, Scaduto AA, Ebramzadeh E, Sangiorgio SN
source.sample: systematic review: 23 cadaveric pure-moment studies without rib cage (study-level values)

protocol.summary: Secondary pooled estimate; not a single experiment.
how_to_simulate: Use only as a coarse plausibility band for FSU ROM without rib cage (mixed moments 1.5-8 Nm)
protocol.notes: Includes primary studies also extracted here (e.g. Oxland 1992, Wilke 2017 not included - published 2017; Panjabi 1976). Do not pool with primary studies.

data.note: n = number of contributing study means (not stated per level; T1-T2, T2-T3, T3-T4 from one study each)
